name: Marriage Royale ~Prism Story~
original_name: マリッジロワイヤル ～プリズムストーリー～
source:
Marriage Royale's story revolves around the male protagonist, a high school student named Hinomoto Tsukasa, who is told one day by his parents that he was adopted. Furthermore, they tell him that his real father is a manager of a large company, meaning he is very rich and holds a lot of power. Tsukasa's real father wants his son to marry a good woman, so he sets up an event known as Marriage Royale where beautiful girls from all over Japan will come together at a school built especially for the event and vie to become Tsukasa's fiancé. The school is located on an isolated island near Japan, and Tsukasa himself is taken there to live in a mansion in the care of two twin maids: Miku, the elder sister, and Miu, the younger sister.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marriage_Royale]Wikipedia[/url]]

There are various paths the player can take in the game beyond the main marriage path provided that the player fulfills the correct requirements to open those paths up. These paths are designated by different colors and include a red route which involves investigating dangerous ruins and a yellow route which involves the girls aiming to be idols.

[From [url=http://www.akiba-station.com/blog/?p=9330]Akiba-Station[/url]]
translation:
《Marriage Royale》的故事围绕高中生主人公日乃本司展开。一天，父母告诉他，自己其实是被收养的。不仅如此，他的亲生父亲还是一家大企业的经营者，既富有又权势显赫。司的亲生父亲希望儿子迎娶一位优秀女性，于是举办了一场名为"Marriage Royale"的活动：来自日本各地的美丽女孩齐聚一座专门为活动建造的学校，争夺司未婚妻的位置。学校坐落在日本附近的一座孤岛上，司本人也被带到岛上居住于宅邸，由双胞胎女仆照料：姐姐美久和妹妹美宇。

[摘自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marriage_Royale]Wikipedia[/url]]

只要满足相应条件，玩家除主要婚姻路线外，还能开启多条不同路线。这些路线以颜色区分，包括调查危险遗迹的红色路线，以及女孩们立志成为偶像的黄色路线。

[摘自[url=http://www.akiba-station.com/blog/?p=9330]Akiba-Station[/url]]
